transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I’m here because… I’ve been hearing things at work. Voices, I guess. From the call-light speaker, sometimes the hallway vents. They’ll say which patient records were changed. It sounds very clear, like someone standing right next to me, even when it’s quiet and nobody else seems to hear it.
During this time, have you had a period of feeling unusually high, energized, or irritable for days at a time?

Yeah… some days, I guess. I feel like I’m finally awake, like I can see what needs fixing at work. And if my husband or one of the nurses tells me to slow down, I get… really irritated. Like they’re getting in the way of something important.
Do you believe someone is deliberately sending you these messages through the speaker or vents?

I… I don’t know if I’d say it like that. But the wound-care charts have a pattern, and management doesn’t want it noticed. My supervisor keeps saying it’s just late entries or coding mistakes, but… I can tell they’re watching what I write. I’m the one who caught it.
Before the voices started, had you used any drugs or stimulants, like methamphetamine, cocaine, or extra ADHD medication?
I’m not sure. I mean… not like that, no. I don’t use things like that.
How long have you been hearing the voices?
Maybe… about two months. Around when they asked me to help with that wound-care documentation rollout. It kind of started then.
Have you felt like someone else was putting thoughts into your mind?

I don’t know if it’s someone putting thoughts in my mind. It’s more… I just know there’s a pattern in those wound-care charts, and management doesn’t want it seen. My supervisor keeps calling it late entries or coding mistakes, but I can tell they’re watching what I write. I’m the one who noticed it.
Have you found yourself feeling less motivated or emotionally flat lately?
I don’t really know. I mean… I still get things done. I haven’t been paying much attention to that.
During these past two months, have you had a period of feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I’m not sure. I mean, I’ve had some bad days, but… I don’t think I’ve been keeping track like that.
During this time, have you been needing much less sleep than usual and still feeling rested?
I’m not really sure. My sleep’s been a little off, maybe, but I don’t know that I’d say I needed way less and felt rested.
Have you had any seizures?
No… not that I know of.
Have you felt that other people can hear or know your thoughts, even when you haven’t said them out loud?

Not exactly hearing my thoughts… but I do feel like they know what I’m noticing. Like with the wound-care charts—there’s a pattern there, and management doesn’t want it out. My supervisor says it’s just late entries or coding mistakes, but… I can tell they’re watching what I write because I’m the one who caught it.
Have people told you that your speech has been hard to follow or that you jump from one idea to another?

Maybe. I mean… I’ve been told I’m hard to follow sometimes. It’s just my mind keeps jumping—from wound measurements, to patient initials, to dates on the forms, to what it all means. Like there are too many tabs open and I can’t get them to close.
Have you been acting in ways that other people said were very strange or disorganized?
I don’t know… I don’t think so. People might say I’ve been a little intense or hard to follow, but strange? I’m not sure what they mean by that.
Since these experiences began, has your ability to do your job gotten worse?

Yeah… it has. I don’t really like saying that, but… I was taken off the floor during a shift. My supervisor said my handoffs and charting weren’t safe anymore.

And at home, my husband’s had to take over things I normally handle. It feels like… my reputation at work, and even LPN school, it’s all kind of falling apart.
During these past two months, have the voices or beliefs about the charts ever continued for at least two weeks when you were not feeling unusually energized or irritable?

No… I don’t think so.

The voices and the chart stuff didn’t happen before I got so wound up with the rollout. It was after I stopped sleeping much and kept working nonstop… feeling like I had to fix everything there.
During this period, did you feel like you had special abilities or an unusually important mission?

I mean… I wouldn’t say “special abilities.” But I did feel like I was the one who could see what was going on in the wound-care charts.

There’s a pattern there. Management says it’s just late entries or coding mistakes, but… I don’t think that’s all it is. I felt like I had to catch it, because they were watching what I wrote.
